title: Donut craft his father showed him

tellings.quote: My father said to me, "Hey, come take a look one time one of the three times." And it was your typical it was like a donut shaped craft.

plain: Dave Rossi says his father once called him outside at their old house to see a craft that was "your typical, like a donut shaped craft." Rossi tells Michels this was one of three times something like it appeared there, a sighting he describes as his own.
